pictures.name: JO1-The-Coat
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A shepherd family’s tent camp in the hills of Canaan at golden evening. An old father with a white beard and a deep green mantle, Jacob, shown ONLY from behind, his face never visible, lovingly places a long, richly colored striped coat in reds, blues and golds on the shoulders of his young son Joseph, shown ONLY from behind, his face never visible. In the background, his ten older brothers, rugged shepherds with beards in rough striped wool robes, watch with folded arms and jealous, resentful faces. Love and envy.
